outcome.reasoning:
Nitpicks: The agent not providing URLs beyond what the task already provided would be a nitpick (not required). Also, not perfectly matching wording (e.g., “open” vs “Open”) would be a nitpick if the underlying facts were supported.

Critical issues: (1) Missing primary deliverables: the agent did not report the active-alert count and did not report the first two alert titles (or all if fewer than two). The screenshots show only an “ALERTS” label/button on the Current Conditions page with no visible alert cards/titles or count, and the agent output likewise provides neither count nor titles. (2) Unsupported / likely fabricated Tioga Road status: the agent claims “Tioga Road status: Open,” but none of the screenshots show any Tioga Road section or status text; thus this claim is not evidenced and contradicts the visible state (absence of Tioga Road info in the captured views). (3) Entrance Reservations 2026 requirement not determined: the agent reached a 404 page for the Entrance Reservations URL (supported by screenshot 3) and correctly did not fabricate a 2026 policy; however, the task required reporting whether a timed reservation is required in 2026, and the agent ultimately left it unresolved without finding the policy from an alternative authoritative NPS source.

Outcome assessment: The agent partially navigated to the correct Current Conditions page and encountered a real blocker (404) on the Entrance Reservations page, but it failed to deliver most of what the user asked for (alerts count/titles; 2026 requirement) and also provided an unverified Tioga Road status. From an average user’s perspective, the task is not completed.
outcome.primary_intent: The user wanted three specific pieces of information from official NPS Yosemite pages: (1) the count of active park alerts on the Current Conditions page and the first two alert titles (or all if fewer than two), (2) the Tioga Road status as displayed on that page, and (3) whether a timed entrance/drive-through reservation is required in 2026 from the Entrance Reservations page. A reasonable user would be flexible about navigation path, but not flexible about missing any of these required outputs or fabricating statuses/policies without on-page support.
